purpose: Experimental WebGL features and GPU performance profiles

features.name: Dynamic Lighting Profiles
features.description: WebGL environment presets (DEFAULT, TOXIC_HAZE, VOID_ECLIPSE, AURORA_STORM) dynamically transitioned via LERP based on active biome and global entropy.

features.name: Adaptive Post-Processing SSAO
features.description: GPU-profiler detected performance adaptation. Lowers SSAO sample count and disables mipmap blur on integrated graphics (e.g., Intel Iris Xe) to ensure 60 FPS.

features.name: WebGL Headless Fallback
features.description: Prevents crashes in virtualized CI environments (Docker/Jenkins) by rendering a static simulation UI if WebGL is unavailable.

features.name: Dynamic Spell Flash Beams
features.description: Expanding 3D hexagonal ring shockwaves rendered on the targeted tiles when cards are played, tinted according to active weather.

features.name: experimental_v2 Cartesian Guidance HUD
features.description: Practical senior-level integration framework calculating 3D Cartesian coordinates (X, Y, Z), Euclidean distances, and generating deterministic trajectory scripts synced to SQLite.

features.name: experimental_v2 Visual Cost Estimator
features.description: Interactive segment path line and floating overlays rendered directly inside the WebGL canvas, estimating action cost and available trajectory vectors.
